composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# First step: idempotent create. A repeat with an already-seen 'Idempotency-Key' header replays the
# originally created owner (200) via 'replay'; otherwise 'create' enters the normal pipeline.
checkIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CheckIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  outputs:
    replay: respondExisting
    create: validate

respondExisting:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithExistingOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]

validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: validatePostcode

validatePostcode:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidatePostcode
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeTelephone

normalizeTelephone:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerTelephone
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeEmail

normalizeEmail:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerEmail
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeAddress

normalizeAddress:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeOwnerAddress
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureCityCapacity

ensureCityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureOwnerCityCapacity
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: normalizeRegistrationDate

normalizeRegistrationDate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.NormalizeRegistrationDate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureDailyLimit

ensureDailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureDailyOwnerLimit
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMemberId

assignMemberId:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMemberId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHousehold

assignHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdId
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: ensureIdentityUnique

ensureIdentityUnique:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.EnsureOwnerIdentityUnique
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignHouseholdSize

assignHouseholdSize:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignHouseholdSize
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignNamesakeCount

assignNamesakeCount:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignNamesakeCount
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignPossibleDuplicate

assignPossibleDuplicate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignPossibleDuplicate
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: assignMembershipLevel

assignMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AssignMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: capMembershipLevel

# A new owner's level cannot exceed one above the current maximum among their existing household
# members; with no existing member no cap applies.
capMembershipLevel:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.CapMembershipLevel
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: recordIdempotency

# Owner now has its id; remember the Idempotency-Key (if any) so a repeat replays this owner.
recordIdempotency:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RecordIdempotencyKey
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

All tests pass (263 run, 0 failures, 0 errors — including the new `AcceptanceTest.coreEnqueuesWelcome`).

## Summary

I implemented the welcome-notification requirement for `POST /api/owners`.

**New function** — `EnqueueWelcomeNotification.java`: emits a line to the SLF4J logger named `NOTIFY` containing the owner id and `memberId`, mirroring the existing `AuditOwnerCreated` pattern. It reads the `@Val Owner`, which by that point in the pipeline has both its persisted id (from `SaveOwner`) and its `memberId` (from `AssignMemberId`).

**Pipeline wiring** — `owners.POST.yml`: inserted a `notify` step between `audit` and `respond`, under the same `transaction` governance as the rest of the create pipeline, so it only runs on a successful create.

The captured log confirms the behavior, e.g. `NOTIFY - welcome owner id=11 memberId=NSW2716E6609E1`, which satisfies the test's assertion that a NOTIFY line contains both the id and the memberId.
